title: Orbit maths for the first US orbital flight
summary: Johnson calculated trajectories, launch windows and emergency return paths for Mercury flights, including John Glenn's first US orbit.
why: Her numbers helped carry the first Americans into orbit and home.

unsung.contribution: Calculated trajectories and return paths for Project Mercury flights, including John Glenn's orbit.
unsung.recognition: Wide public honour came decades later: the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2015 and the 2016 film Hidden Figures.
